probes.name: types_add
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim v(11) As Variant, i As Long, j As Long, s As String, r As Variant
v(0) = CByte(2): v(1) = CInt(2): v(2) = CLng(2): v(3) = CLngLng(2): v(4) = CSng(2): v(5) = CDbl(2)
v(6) = CCur(2): v(7) = CDec(2): v(8) = CDate(2): v(9) = "2": v(10) = True: v(11) = Empty
On Error Resume Next
For i = 0 To 11
For j = 0 To 11
Err.Clear
r = Empty
r = v(i) + v(j)
If Err.Number Then s = s & "e" & Err.Number & "," Else s = s & Left(TypeName(r), 3) & ","
Next
s = s & ";"
Next
Probe = s
End Function

probes.name: byte_bitwise
probes.macro:

Dim a As Byte, b As Byte
a = 12: b = 10
Probe = TypeName(a And b) & TypeName(a Or b) & TypeName(a Xor b) & TypeName(Not a) & "|" & (Not a) & "|" & TypeName(a And 1)

probes.name: zero_to_negative_power

Function Probe() As String
On Error Resume Next
Dim r As Double
r = 0 ^ -1
Probe = Err.Number
End Function

probes.name: mid_statement
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim s As String
s = "abcdef"
Mid(s, 2, 3) = "XYZW"
Probe = s
Mid(s, 5) = "12345"
Probe = Probe & "|" & s
Mid$(s, 1, 1) = "q"
Probe = Probe & "|" & s
End Function

probes.name: as_new_array
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim c(1) As New Collection
With c(1)
.Add 1
.Add 2
End With
Probe = c(1).Count & "|" & c(0).Count & "|" & TypeName(c) & "|" & (c(0) Is Nothing)
End Function

probes.name: like_bracket_edges
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
On Error Resume Next
Dim r As Boolean
r = ("a" Like "[")
Probe = Err.Number & "|" & r
Err.Clear
r = ("-" Like "[-a]")
Probe = Probe & "|" & r & ("b" Like "[a-]") & ("[" Like "[[]") & ("^" Like "[^]") & ("&" Like "[&]")
End Function

probes.name: date_arithmetic
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim d As Date
d = #1/1/2024#
Probe = TypeName(d + 1) & TypeName(d - 1) & TypeName(d - d) & TypeName(d * 1) & TypeName(1 - d) & TypeName(-d) & "|" & (d + 1) & "|" & (d - #12/31/2023#) & "|" & (5 - d)
End Function
